newsitem.title: USA: Sequa suit against United Tech begins.
newsitem.headline: Sequa suit against United Tech begins.

text.p: Sequa Corp's Chromalloy subsidiary said on Monday its antitrust lawsuit against United Technologies Corp and its jet aircraft unit begins today in Bexar County District Court in Texas.

Chromalloy contends that United Technologies's Pratt & Whitney has been engaged in a scheme to prevent Sequa from providing parts for Pratt & Whitney commercial jet engines, the company said. Chromalloy said United Technologies has caused hundreds of millions of dollars in damages.
United Technologies was not immediately available for comment.
Pratt & Whitney spokesman Larry Churchill said the claims have no merit and the company does not expect any adverse financial effects from the trial result.
